"""Meridian CRM 4.2 permission-check migration."""


def can(
    user: dict,
    action: str,
    object: str,
    record: dict,
    role_rows: list[dict],
) -> bool:
    """Return whether the user may perform the action on the record."""
    role_id = user.get("ROLE_ID", "")
    matching_rows = (
        row
        for row in role_rows
        if row.get("role_id", "") == role_id
        and row.get("object", "") == object
        and row.get("action", "") == action
    )

    if action == "DELETE" and record.get("DEL_FLG", "") not in ("", "N"):
        return False

    if role_id == "ADMIN":
        return any(True for _ in matching_rows)

    user_id = user.get("USR_ID", "")
    user_team = user.get("TEAM_CD", "")
    owner_id = record.get("OWNER_UID", "")
    owner_team = record.get("TEAM_CD", "")

    for row in matching_rows:
        scope = row.get("scope", "")
        if scope == "ALL":
            return True
        if scope == "TEAM" and user_team == owner_team:
            return True
        if scope == "OWN" and owner_id == user_id:
            return True

    return False
